'''Blaudu Octus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Regulan system/Legends|Regulan system]], near [[Blaudu Sextus]]. It was home to the [[Octusi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] species who lived as willing servants to the people of Blaudu Sextus until [[Freedom Flight]] stirred a [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]] amongst the Octusi in [[44 ABY]].
